title: Robinhood Chain research analyst configuration
description: Validates config.example.yaml and any user copy of it. Unknown keys are errors on purpose: a silently ignored typo means the analyst runs with defaults the user believes they changed.

risk_posture.description: How aggressively to treat an unresolved control as a risk. Conservative reports an unverified control as a live risk; permissive reports it as an open question.

default_mode.description: Default depth when the user does not say. triage is identity and controls only; deep runs every configured focus area.

audience.description: Vocabulary and what gets explained versus assumed.

language.description: BCP 47 tag for report prose, e.g. en or id.

environment.description: Which Robinhood Chain environment every claim in the report refers to.

expected_chain_id.description: The chain id the RPC must report before any onchain claim is made. Seeded values are 4663 mainnet and 46630 testnet; confirm against current official documentation.

verify_chain_id_before_use.description: Read eth_chainId and compare before trusting any endpoint.

verify_documentation_before_use.description: Re-check official docs for endpoints and chain ids rather than trusting the seeded values.

allow_environment_switch.description: never_silently permits a switch the analyst states out loud and re-verifies; never refuses entirely.

focus.description: Focus areas to cover, in order. Each maps to a playbook in references/investigation-playbooks.md.

exit_sizes_usd.description: Notional sizes to model when answering whether an ordinary holder can actually sell.

include_historical_launch_analysis.description: when_triggered means run it if the target is young, concentrated, or the user asks about the launch.

max_initial_provider_requests.description: Network requests before pausing to report and ask for more budget.

max_initial_provider_operations.description: Distinct research steps before the same pause. A paginated scan is many requests, one operation.

max_failed_attempts_per_check.description: Retries per individual check before recording it as a coverage limitation and moving on.

pons_default_selection.description: What to do when a target is named by symbol, name, or ticker instead of an exact address. require_address never guesses: it lists candidates with addresses and stops.

report_depth.description: How much of the evidence appendix is inlined in the report.

log_block_range_limit.description: Largest block span for one eth_getLogs call before splitting. Public endpoints usually cap this.

require_block_pin.description: Onchain evidence must record the block it was read at. Turning this off makes findings unreproducible.

require_exact_address_binding.description: Every contract claim must carry the exact address it was read from. Turning this off allows symbol-level confusion.

allow_dashboard_only_claims.description: Whether an aggregator dashboard alone may support a proven or strongly supported finding. Off by default.

preserve_raw_evidence.description: Keep raw responses so a reading can be re-checked later.

primary_rpc_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the preferred RPC URL. The value is never read from this file.

secondary_rpc_env.description: An independent endpoint used to corroborate a surprising reading.

geckoterminal_network_id.description: GeckoTerminal's own id for this chain. Leave empty until confirmed from their network list; an invented id silently returns another chain's pools.

alchemy_url_template.description: Endpoint template with {key} where the credential goes. Leave empty until the current format is confirmed in Alchemy's own documentation; the helpers refuse to guess it.

drpc_url_template.description: Same rule as Alchemy: confirm the current format from dRPC's documentation before filling this in.

env_aliases.description: Map a logical slot, or a default variable name, to whatever variable you already have set. Example: primary_rpc: MY_L2_RPC.

x_custom.description: Free-form space for your own keys. Never validated, never read by the helpers.
